{{recipesummary|category=Soup recipes|servings=8|time=1 hour|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive oil|olive oil]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]] chopped
* 1 [[Cookbook:Garlic|clove garlic]], chopped
* 3½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] canned [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Dill|dill seeds]]
* 3 cups frozen [[Cookbook:Corn|corn]] kernels
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (675 g) medium [[Cookbook:shrimp|shrimp]], shelled
* ¼ cup light [[cookbook:Cream|cream]] or [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 1 tablespoon fresh [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], chopped
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] and [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
# In a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], heat olive oil over low heat.
# Add onion, carrot and garlic.
# Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is transparent, about 5 minutes.
# Add broth and dill seeds.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]].
# Reduce heat and [[Cookbook:Simmer|simmer]], covered, for 20 minutes.
# Add corn to broth and simmer, covered, until the corn is just tender, about 5 minutes.
# In a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] or [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]], [[Cookbook:Puree|puree]] the newly made chowder and pour it back into the saucepan.
# Add shelled shrimp, simmer and cook until shrimp are almost done, about 1 minute.
# Stir in milk and parsley, salt and pepper.
# Bring mixture back to simmer.
# Serve immediately.
